signal: Celigo launched Ora AI Copilot and Agent Builder, extending its iPaaS into adaptive AI agents

email.body1:
Matthew, saw Celigo just launched Ora AI Copilot and Agent Builder.

A launch that big usually pulls more in-market accounts into the funnel than your strategic team can touch before the moment passes, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Celigo off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Matthew, quick follow-up for Celigo.

Strategic sales lives or dies on coverage, yet most teams don't actually know how many meetings it takes to hit the number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble. Reps buried in research and CRM instead of selling only widens it.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Celigo needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Matthew, last bit of proof for Celigo.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Celigo's reply rate likely compares to other iPaaS teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Matthew, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Rolling out a new AI copilot is its own kind of busy, and I know timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a strategic sales motion? I'll tailor it to Celigo either way.
